description: Authoring-side field catalog for the site-visit claim form, paired with rubric-site-visit.json (the ExternalSource geo form — anchorable today). The deployed form is a claim-template LinkedResource (#vct) on did:ixo:entity:outcome-site-visit-v0; its content hash goes into the rubric's claimSchema.proof. Coordinates are INTEGER MICRO-DEGREES (1e-6°) — claimant tooling converts device/EXIF degrees before the body is canonicalized; the oracle rejects float degrees with a 400. The v2-pending twin catalog (v2-pending/claim-form.site-visit.catalog.json) replaces the split lat/lon numbers and boundaryRef with native geo-kind fields.

fields.name: boundaryRef
fields.description: Content address of the program catchment boundary (urn:ixo:geo-boundary:...). Gate OSV-001 pins it to the exact address in the rubric hash; the oracle digest-verifies the bytes on every answer.

fields.name: waterPointId
fields.description: Registered water point visited (a reference point_id in the boundary artifact, e.g. wp-kitui-014) — the withinRadius center.

fields.name: visitDate
fields.description: Date of the site visit (dedup key with waterPointId — one claim per point per date).

fields.name: captureLat
fields.description: Capture latitude in integer micro-degrees (1e-6°), e.g. -1366000 for -1.366°.

fields.name: captureLon
fields.description: Capture longitude in integer micro-degrees (1e-6°), e.g. 38016000 for 38.016°.

fields.name: sitePhoto
fields.description: Geotagged site photo (jpeg/png). EXIF extraction happens in claimant tooling — never in the engine or oracle decision path.

fields.name: flowLitersPerHour
fields.description: Measured flow rate, integer liters/hour (claimant-supplied; criterion OSC-103 is trust-capped).
